node.statement: Correction to the challenged regularity inference: do not infer C^1 regularity of the inverse from a merely C^1 graph frame. Instead use node 1.3.1.2: the differentiated defining equation gives the explicit smooth formula Dg_U(0)=-B_U^{-1}C_U, with B_U and C_U polynomial in U and B_U invertible by the upstream near-identity estimate. Hence the already identified fibrewise inverse (U,A) maps to (U,L_U(A+Dg_U(0)A)) is C^1 directly. The counterexample in the challenge is inapplicable precisely because its graph derivative has no analogous smooth implicit-equation formula with invertible normal derivative.
